name: predator-free
description: Predator Free Aotearoa above the Claude Code prompt: a ranger holds the line against waves of possums, stoats and rats before they reach the kiwi. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. Adapted from the invaders mod in cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs an interactive terminal with a mouse.

author.name: David Wells (adapted from Seza Akgün's cc-arcade)
